title: Unknown enumeration values fold onto the documented fallback
description: A consumer reading a document that uses values it does not know must not refuse it: an unknown kind reads as text and an unknown betterWhen as none, so neither can decide an order (spec §5.1.6). Here only the second measure can rank anything.

rankings.label: Main
rankings.description: vibe leads sortBy and decides nothing: its direction is unknown, so it folds to none and is skipped (§8.2.2, §5.1.6).
